call_points.text: 25 Mn Pens capacity addition underway with automation machines under commissioning and validation.
Management expects FY27 pen volumes to exceed the 36 million guidance, citing strong demand and improving line efficiency.
Additional 25 million pen capacity is expected operational by end-September, taking installed capacity to about 75 million pens a year.
Gross margin fell sequentially on post-March polymer and freight cost rises; pass-through lagged, with normalisation expected by Q3.
Pens are not cost-plus contracts; pricing is volume and market driven with annual price review mechanisms.
Commercial supply of Consumer Electronics components has started; 5 new components from a new customer should be in supply before fiscal year-end.
Semiconductor tray revenue is expected to start in Q4 of this financial year.
Consumer segment is expected to hold at FY26 levels this year, not grow, on weak Europe/US home furnishings.
Innovator partnerships: management is confident of an announcement within the next 4-6 quarters after hiring regional BD heads for Europe and the US.
New device pipeline: reusable auto-injector to be showcased at CPHI Milan; emergency-use auto-injector targeted for closure by end-2027.
Chinese GLP-1 pen competition is priced around $1.50-1.70 versus Shaily's above $2; management said it is not too concerned.
Commercial supplies for semiconductor trays to start in Q4 FY27.
Additional 25 million capacity for Semaglutide expected by July, August.

operating_notes.text: Company signed a supply agreement with a Korean firm for the manufacture and supply of semiconductor trays.
ShailyPen Neo is a proprietary spring-driven variable and fixed dose pen injector platform compatible with ISO-standard 3 mL cartridges.
Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY26 compared to 42.2% last year.
About 9 million delivery devices shipped in Q1FY27, roughly 50-60% GLP-1 and the rest insulin and other molecules.
Machine utilisation was 50.2% in Q1FY27 versus 48.7% in Q1FY26; exports were about 58% of revenue versus 76% a year ago.
Abu Dhabi capacity has roughly 50-55% commitments or indications, with commercial sales targeted by end-FY28.

timeline.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹236.8 Cr, up 9% YoY, with PAT at ₹40.2 Cr.
Mahendra Bhogilal Sanghvi, as authorized signatory, declared no encumbrance on 43.40% promoter shares (19,942,600) of Shaily Engineering Plastics as of March 31, 2026.
Shaily Engineering secured USFDA tentative approval, Health Canada notice of compliance, and CDSCO approval for generic Semaglutide injection incorporating ShailyPen Neo pen platform.
Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited uploaded earnings call recording on 20th May 2026 via www.shaily.com/investors.
Shaily Engineering Plastics reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹237 Cr, up 9% YoY, with PAT at ₹40 Cr.

On its 10 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Shaily said Healthcare revenue rose 85% YoY to ₹142 Cr (about 51% of revenue) while Consumer fell 24% to ₹116 Cr, and that FY27 pen volumes should exceed the 36 million guidance.
Shaily Engineering Plastics submitted its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Shaily Engineering allots 1,300 ESOP shares at ₹732 each, raising ₹9.52 lakh
Shaily Engineering reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹319.5 Cr and PAT of ₹61.3 Cr, driven by healthcare segment growth.
Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited uploaded earnings call recording on 30th October 2026 via [www.shaily.com/investors](https://www.shaily.com/investors).
